adoptedSignAuthority: Continue using the separately archived adopted Boone County Zoning Regulations Article 34 as sign-regulation authority unless newer official evidence establishes final adoption and an effective replacement.
evidenceScope: As checked on 2026-10-03, the official rewrite Meetings / Workshops page still describes the Zoning Regulations as draft and lists only the April 29 committee meeting and July 16 public workshop. It contains no September or October adoption hearing/action entry and no final-adoption or effective-date statement. That absence is evidence about this page only; it is not proof that no adoption action occurred elsewhere. The page therefore does not establish replacement authority for the separately archived adopted Article 34 sign regulations.
